parameters.help_en:
The language of the received messages.

Valid values:

zh: (default) Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：（默认）中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The task type. For valid values, call the operation that queries file download task types
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，枚举值。可填枚举值见接口：查询文件下载任务类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The request query conditions for the download task. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns error code -340408 (download task TaskData invalid)
parameters.help_zh: 下载任务的请求查询条件。本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回错误码 -340408（download task TaskData invalid），不可省略
parameters.name: task_data

parameters.help_en: The time zone for time information in the downloaded file. Specify the value in IANA time zone identity format. Default value: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 下载文件中时间信息的时区，使用IANA时区标识符。默认为北京时间，即Asia/Shanghai
parameters.name: time_zone

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

finish: The task is completed. You can call a task query operation to obtain the download URL of the task file.

start: The task has started.

error: The task failed.

expire: The task has expired. The task file is no longer valid and cannot be downloaded.

This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is completed synchronously. In regular responses, only RequestId is returned. Use a task query operation to obtain the real-time status
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

finish：任务完成。即任务已经完成，可以通过查询任务，获取任务文件下载链接。

start：任务开始。

error：任务失败。

expire：任务过期。即任务文件已经失效，无法下载。

注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId；请通过任务查询类接口查询实时状态

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which uniquely identifies the task. This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is completed synchronously. In regular responses, only RequestId is returned. Use a task query operation to obtain the task status and download URL
TaskId.description_zh: 任务Id，任务的唯一标识。注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId；请通过任务查询类接口获取任务状态与下载链接

TaskName.description_en: The name of the file download task. This field is returned only under specific conditions, such as when the task is completed synchronously. In regular responses, only RequestId is returned
TaskName.description_zh: 文件下载任务的名称。注意：本字段仅在任务同步完成等特定条件下返回，常规响应仅返回 RequestId
